summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel (Live Patch 3 for SUSE Linux Enterprise 15 SP7)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise Kernel 6.4.0-150700.53.11 fixes various security issues

The following security issues were fixed:

- CVE-2025-40309: Bluetooth: SCO: Fix UAF on sco_conn_free (bsc#1255066).
- CVE-2026-23268: apparmor: fix unprivileged local user can do privileged policy management (bsc#1259859).
